title: Require LaTeX math in Markdown documents
description: Adds Markdown document formatting rules so technical notes and paper explanations use standard LaTeX math delimiters instead of code blocks or Unicode pseudo-formulas.
changes: Disallow math formulas in code blocks unless the content is actual code or pseudocode.
Disallow Unicode pseudo-formulas as a replacement for LaTeX in Markdown documents.

rollback.notes: Restore the previous AGENTS snapshot if LaTeX formatting guidance has unwanted side effects.
